title: Uganda Declares End of 2026 Ebola Outbreak
detail: Uganda's Ministry of Health officially declared the end of its 2026 Ebola outbreak on 28 July 2026, citing complete epidemiological investigation, identification of the outbreak's DRC-imported source, and successful contact tracing with no further community transmission. The declaration came before the standard WHO 42-day waiting period, which Uganda argued was not the sole criterion once an outbreak is fully characterized with confirmed epidemiological closure. Uganda's outbreak totaled 20 confirmed cases, 18 recoveries and 2 deaths; the last patient was discharged 16 July after testing negative. Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi said: 'Today, Uganda is Ebola-free.' Uganda's border with DRC remained closed as the DRC outbreak continued to escalate.

media.caption: Uganda Ministry of Health declares the 2026 Ebola outbreak over
